mapper.insert: insert into link_share (title, description, link_url, source_name, tags_json, sort, status, created_by) values (#{linkShare.title},#{linkShare.description},#{linkShare.linkUrl},#{linkShare.sourceName},#{linkShare.tags},#{linkShare.sort},#{linkShare.status},#{linkShare.createdBy})
mapper.update: update link_share set title = #{linkShare.title}, description = #{linkShare.description}, link_url = #{linkShare.linkUrl}, source_name = #{linkShare.sourceName}, tags_json = #{linkShare.tags}, sort = #{linkShare.sort}, status = #{linkShare.status}, updated_at = NOW() where id = #{linkShare.id}
update link_share set status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select ls.id, ls.title, ls.description, ls.link_url, ls.source_name, ls.tags_json AS tags, ls.sort, ls.status, u.nickname AS created_by_name, ls.created_at AS create_time, ls.updated_at AS update_time from link_share ls left join user u on ls.created_by = u.id where ( #{keyword} is null or ls.title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ls.description like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ls.source_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or ls.tags_json like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) and ( #{sourceName} is null or ls.source_name = #{sourceName} ) order by ls.sort desc, ls.created_at desc, ls.id desc

select ls.id, ls.title, ls.description, ls.link_url, ls.source_name, ls.tags_json AS tags, ls.sort, ls.status, u.nickname AS created_by_name, ls.created_at AS create_time, ls.updated_at AS update_time from link_share ls left join user u on ls.created_by = u.id where ls.id = #{id}

select ls.id, ls.title, ls.description, ls.link_url, ls.source_name, ls.tags_json AS tags, ls.sort, ls.status, u.nickname AS created_by_name, ls.created_at AS create_time, ls.updated_at AS update_time from link_share ls left join user u on ls.created_by = u.id where ls.id = #{id} and ls.status = 1
